SUMMARY.what_is_tested: Rx8 as a genealogical derivation from the first relation.
SUMMARY.how_it_is_tested: Every later layer must be derived and must not claim origin status.
SUMMARY.why_it_is_tested: To lock relation before projection and prevent after-constructions from becoming origin claims.
SUMMARY.final_result: PASS means the genealogy is locked. FAIL means an ungrounded later relation was introduced.

TRACE.title: VERIFY_FIRST_RELATION_POSITION
TRACE.how_it_is_tested: The script verifies that 1/3 + 2/3 = 1 and that this node alone may claim origin status.
TRACE.why_it_is_tested: This prevents later representations from being mistaken for the first relation.
TRACE.final_result: First relation is locked as origin.

TRACE.title: DERIVE_FIRST_REPRESENTATION
TRACE.how_it_is_tested: The script verifies that 1/4 + 3/4 = 1 and that the representation is derived from RELATION_ORIGIN_1.
TRACE.why_it_is_tested: This locks representation as after-construction, not as a new primary relation.
TRACE.final_result: First representation is derived and does not claim origin.

TRACE.title: CHECK_NO_NEW_RELATION_CREATED
TRACE.what_is_tested: Whether representation creates a new relation.
TRACE.how_it_is_tested: The script checks that the representation remains derived, cannot claim origin, and does not use PRIMARY_ORIGIN_RELATION as its claim.
TRACE.why_it_is_tested: This is the lock against circular self-confirmation and false origin transfer.
TRACE.final_result: Representation did not create a new primary relation.

TRACE.title: VALIDATE_RX8_CAPSULATION
TRACE.how_it_is_tested: The script keeps R symbolic and verifies that four square sides of 2R create 8R without measuring R.
TRACE.why_it_is_tested: This shows Rx8 as reconstruction of R, not as a new origin value.
TRACE.final_result: Rx8 is validated as capsulation and reconstruction.

TRACE.title: VALIDATE_RESIDUAL_LAYER
TRACE.what_is_tested: Whether float residual belongs to representation.
TRACE.how_it_is_tested: The script compares exact 3/4 and 1/4 against float-derived values and checks symmetric residual cancellation.
TRACE.why_it_is_tested: This proves residual as representation trace, not as a mutation of the relation.
TRACE.final_result: Residual is isolated to representation and exact relation remains unchanged.

TRACE.title: FAIL_IF_LATER_LAYER_INTRODUCES_UNGROUNDED_RELATION
TRACE.what_is_tested: Whether any later layer introduces an ungrounded origin relation.
TRACE.how_it_is_tested: The script scans every non-relation node and fails if it claims origin or lacks a derivation source.
TRACE.why_it_is_tested: This is the final lock: no after-construction may be promoted into origin.
TRACE.final_result: No later layer introduced an ungrounded primary relation.
